parsed.answer: The evidence states that the three initiation factors (IFs 1-3) enable start-codon selection, and specifically that IF3 (together with tRNA) undergoes large conformational changes to facilitate accommodation of fMet-tRNA(fMet) into the P site for start codon recognition. Thus the corpus directly attributes a role in start codon recognition to IF3.
